content.value: A job is rated in terms of wages of TK 800 per day. The standard time set for the job is 10 15 days, 8 hrs/day. Two workers have taken 76 and 86 hours respectively for the completion of the job. A bonus of 75% on the time taken will be given only to those who have completed the job in the standard time. Calculate the earnings of each individual by Bedaux plan.
